chiru: Khashole Jerusalem ah put ah Pharisee hai le danoja hai na Jesu dieng va ua ruti uh,
english: Then the scribes and Pharisees who were from Jerusalem came to Jesus, saying,

chiru: Jesu na mashang a amani dieng ruti, Nang shena u jarkhan ijar a Pathien chawngpek kha nangikhoi u maw nih?
english: Why do Your disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? For they do not wash their hands

chiru: Inia nangni na nangti uh Tunita awm unu ninawkle apa dieng Ih nita awm kiei dieng a nanginemna kha khutchawi inih,
english: He answered and said to them, Why do you also transgress the commandment of God because of your tradition?

chiru: Hitihin nang shena u jarkhan, Pathien chawngpek kha nemna boi nangmachang uh.
english: For God commanded, saying, Honor your father and your mother

chiru: Aw thanunchan thaw miring hai! Isaiah na nang chungchang ua thatak a rurophong a ruti,
english: But you say, Whoever says to his father or mother, Whatever profit you might have received from me is a gift to God

chiru: Khan Jesu na mipui kha okoi a amani dieng ruti, Rangai u roh, khan jet u roh.
english: then he need not honor his father or mother. Thus you have made the commandment of God of no effect

chiru: Khashole akhaichawi hai na va ua ama dieng ruti uh, Pharisee hai na nangiriei kha jet u le,
english: Hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy about you, saying:

chiru: Ama na mashang a ruriei, Ravan a awm kapa na iruling boi thingkung rikip kha phawi rangnih.
english: These people draw near to Me with their mouth, And honor Me with their lips, But their heart is far from Me.

chiru: Peter na mashang a ama dieng ruti, Hi rangshim hi kieini dieng nemeler pe u roh.
english: And in vain they worship Me, Teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.

chiru: Inia Jesu na ruti, Nangniawm nangijet boi u maw nih?
english: When He had called the multitude to Himself, He said to them, Hear and understand:

chiru: Jesu na kha mun kha rumathan a Tyre le Sidon ram tieng rushe joi.
english: Not what goes into the mouth defiles a man; but what comes out of the mouth, this defiles a man.

chiru: Khan enro, kha ram ah awm Canaan nupang khat na vak shok a ama dieng rura ai,
english: Then His disciples came and said to Him, Do You know that the Pharisees were offended

chiru: Inia Jesu na ama kha i awm rumashang mak.
english: But He answered and said, Every plant which My heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted.

chiru: Khan akhaichawi hai na ama dieng va uh, khan mawshawklam a ruti uh, Meshe rang roh,
english: Let them alone. They are blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind leads the blind, both will fall into a ditch.

chiru: Inia mashang a ama na ruti, Kiei hi Israel inshung ah athang kengam ranga dieng a inojongtir inih.
english: Then Peter answered and said to Him, Explain this parable to us.

chiru: Inia ama na ava a ama dieng butlam a ruti, Pumi, nashan roh.
english: So Jesus said, Are you also still without understanding?

chiru: Inia mashang a ruti, Naite hai tan kha loi a ui hai dieng vawr rang a hi atha nimak.
english: Do you not yet understand that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and is eliminated?

chiru: Inia ama na ruti, Awh, Pumi, inia ui hai na amani pumi hai tebol ah put ah acho burama hai kha enek.
english: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come from the heart, and they defile a man.

chiru: Khashole mashang a ama dieng ruti, Aw nupang, nang takashawn kha ielien!
english: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies.

chiru: Khan Jesu na kha mun kha rumathan shole, Galilee Thampui tieng rushe joi.
english: These are the things which defile a man, but to eat with unwashed hands does not defile a man.

chiru: Khan lawn ah ruhawng a kha mun khan rushuh.
english: Then Jesus went out from there and departed to the region of Tyre and Sidon.

chiru: Khan mipui lientak khat na ama dieng va uh.
english: And behold, a woman of Canaan came from that region and cried out to Him, Have mercy on me

chiru: Amani na kekhawr, mikchaw, chawngthieiboi, takkhawr, khan shik tampui vak chawi uh,
english: But He answered her not a word. And His disciples came and urged Him, saying, Send her away

chiru: Makha na mipui kha shindawngna rupek.
english: But He answered and said, I was not sent except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

chiru: Chawngthieiboi na achawng, takkhawr na adam, kekhawr na alawn, khan mikchaw na imuk
english: Then she came and worshiped Him, saying, Lord, help me!

chiru: Khashole Jesu na akhaichawi hai kha ama dieng rukoi a ruti, Kiei na mipui dieng hin lainatna kieniei joi.
english: But He answered and said, It is not good to take the children's bread and throw it to the little dogs.

chiru: Akhaichawi hai na ama dieng ruti uh, Hidawr a lien mipui hi vaina rang,
english: And she said, Yes, Lord, yet even the little dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

chiru: Jesu na amani dieng rurawdawn, Tanpek ijat maw nangniei uh? Amani na ruti uh, Shiri le nga shin lekte.
english: Then Jesus answered and said to her, O woman, great is your faith! Let it be to you as you desire.

chiru: Khashole ama na mipui kha pieipak chung ah shutna rang, chawng rupek.
english: Jesus departed from there, skirted the Sea of Galilee, and went up on the mountain and sat down there.

chiru: Ama na tan shiri le nga kha ruloi a mapakna runiei.
english: Then great multitudes came to Him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others

chiru: Khan ama na rukhoi a mipui dieng pekna rang, akhaichawi hai dieng rupek.
english: So the multitude marveled when they saw the mute speaking, the maimed made whole, the lame walking, and the blind seeing

chiru: Khan aneh-ashah kholok kha vawn ruship pe uh.
english: Now Jesus called His disciples to Himself and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now continued with Me three days

chiru: Lekvai mienieng kha lawngkai shiri shipmer a rurawkhawm uh.
english: Then His disciples said to Him, Where could we get enough bread in the wilderness to fill such a great multitude?

chiru: Khan ah runeh-rushah miring hai kha, nupang le naite te boi a, pasha bawp mili runih.
english: Jesus said to them, How many loaves do you have? And they said, Seven, and a few little fish.

chiru: Mipui kha rumeshe shole, ama na rokong shung khan rulut a Magdala ram tieng rushe joi.
english: So He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
And He took the seven loaves and the fish and gave thanks, broke them and gave them to His disciples
So they all ate and were filled, and they took up seven large baskets full of the fragments that were left.
Now those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.
And He sent away the multitude, got into the boat, and came to the region of Magdala.
